video.description:
Learn to explain how to talk about closures that cross tasks, cleanup on an actor and passing values safely: Sendable Closure, Isolated Deinit & Region-Based Isolation, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Sendable Closure - A closure marked @Sendable, which promises it is safe to run on another task or thread.
Isolated Deinit - A deinit marked isolated, so it runs on the actor that owns the object.
Region-Based Isolation - A compiler rule that lets a value cross to another actor when nothing else can still reach it.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Sendable Closure, Isolated Deinit & Region-Based Isolation in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Sendable Closure, Isolated Deinit, Region-Based Isolation 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Sendable Closure - A closure marked @Sendable, which promises it is safe to run on another task or thread.
한국어: Sendable Closure: @Sendable로 표시되어 다른 태스크나 스레드에서 실행해도 안전하다고 약속하는 클로저

Isolated Deinit - A deinit marked isolated, so it runs on the actor that owns the object.
한국어: Isolated Deinit: isolated로 표시되어 객체를 소유한 액터에서 실행되는 deinit

Region-Based Isolation - A compiler rule that lets a value cross to another actor when nothing else can still reach it.
한국어: Region-Based Isolation: 다른 곳에서 더 이상 접근할 수 없는 값은 다른 액터로 넘기게 해 주는 컴파일러 규칙

landscape.hook: Can you explain Sendable Closure, Isolated Deinit and Region-Based Isolation in English?

dialogue.title: Why is this closure not Sendable?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I pass `work` to a Task, and Xcode talks about a Sendable closure.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Mark it `@Sendable`. A Sendable closure promises it is safe to run on another task.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So it can only capture safe values?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right, and the compiler checks every capture.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Now I pass a `Note` to `Box`. It is not Sendable, but there is no error. Why?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Region-based isolation. If nothing else can reach the note, the compiler lets it cross.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And if I use the note after sending it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then you get an error. Region-based isolation only allows a clean handoff.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Last one. My `Screen` cleans up in `deinit`, but it fails on the main actor.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use an isolated deinit. It runs on the actor that owns the object.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nice, no more hops during cleanup.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. A Sendable closure, region-based isolation and an isolated deinit solve these errors.
